name: Xinyan
notes: KQM has no Xinyan guide, so the card rests on Game8 (Physical Main DPS build) and genshin-builds.com (Physical DPS build, checked 2026-10-30), which agree on 4pc Pale Flame or Bloodstained Chivalry (2pc each is the other's alternative), an ATK% or ER Sands, a Physical DMG Goblet, a CRIT Circlet, Redhorn Stonethresher first and Normal Attack > Burst > Skill. Game8's Marechaussee Hunter build (Pyro or Physical Goblet) and its Shield Support build (DEF% or ER Sands, DEF% Goblet and Circlet, 4pc Tenacity of the Millelith, Sacrificial Greatsword first) are kept as sets and weapons only. Game8's talent-priority line was garbled by the draft script (it repeats the three talents); the first three entries are the order. The kit's 'check' line (Sweeping Fervor's Swing DMG, 170% to 305%) is an ATK-based Pyro hit on the elemental curve, with the shield on DEF; the damage talent is the Normal Attack (1-hit 76.5% to 151.3%, ratio 1.98, physical curve). Neither source gives numeric goals, so none is set. Both sources are one voice on the build, so confidence is medium.
